watches.name: STROND SSC-101 GMT Concorde watch, All Stainless Steel & Blue, black bezel
watches.description: The all stainless with blue dial & black bezel 24h GMT......A little bit special ! If you are after a little bit of extra, then the all stainless steel with deep blue dial and black bezel Concorde watch is the one! Comes with the handmade, gorgeous vintage double stitched Khaki army green calfskin leather strap, and a blue NATO strap made from seatbelt material, both with quick release spring bars for ease of strap removal. The material used to make the dial tag is taken from the first and fastest ever Concorde, taken from the bottom panel of the air intake section of the aircraft, which houses the superb Rolls Royce jet engine......not just any old Concorde, rather Concorde 101 which holds the world speed record for a commercial flight of 1,450 mph which it has held for almost 50 years and to date, and has NEVER been beaten ! The SSC-101 GMT limited edition timepice is limited to only 1930 pieces. Classic styling, with a generous 42mm case, Swiss made Ronda quartz movement, all stainless steel, and crystal sapphire glass. As the material was taken from the first Concorde, we have designated the serial number of 001 for each of the first 300 pieces made.

watches.name: SARSEN Automatic, gunmetal case/antique steel bezel watch
watches.description: The world's first STROND Stonehenge watch, which has the whole dial cut from the same stone which was used to make the outer ring of the world famous STONEHENGE ! This is the all stainless steel model, with a gunmetal case finish and stunning antique stainless steel bezel & crown top, both lavishly engraved with the Celtic knot . We are making the whole dial from the same stone they used to make one of the best known “wonders of the ancient world” namely STONEHENGE !. The stone is known as SARSEN stone and comes from "west woods" in Wiltshire, about 20 miles from Stonehenge. She is an absolute Beauty ! Limited Edition with 24 Jewel automatic with PREMIUM movement......limited to only 300 pieces
